newsitem.title: USA: Ex-NY mayor Koch faints briefly at gym.
newsitem.headline: Ex-NY mayor Koch faints briefly at gym.

text.p: Pugnacious former New York City Mayor Ed Koch, 72, fainted briefly Tuesday morning while exercising at a health club in Manhattan, police said.
He regained consciousness after a few minutes and did not require medical attention. He made his regular appearance on his radio talk show.

Koch, brash and abrasive, was city mayor for 12 years before being defeated by David Dinkins in the 1989 Democratic primary as he sought a record fourth term. Dinkins went on to become New York's first black mayor but was defeated after only one term by Republican Rudolph Giuliani.
